statelessNote: Each entry is a gap row of a generated state map (scripts/computed-route/lib/state-map.mjs::stateMap) stated as having no reachable state: a row id, or { surface, id }. scripts/computed-route/state-map.mjs --check fails on a gap row this list does not state; scripts/parity/flows/tests/state-map.test.mjs fails on an entry no current map has.

stateConflicts.owner: Solve refuses a walker-state group an entry names (scripts/computed-route/lib/solve-rows.mjs::namedConflict, passed by solve.mjs through lib/state-map-io.mjs::refusalsFor).
stateConflicts.keys: Each entry is a walker-state group (key "<ref>|<path>|<kind>|<property>", kind `hover` for the hover state) whose pair is measured in two or more walker states that map to the SAME setting state with different draft values, so writing the group would take the last run's value. `walkerStates` are the walker states it is measured in and `mappedTo` each one's setting state as committed in sites/<client>/build/surfaces.json ("<walker state>-><setting state>", rest written `rest`). scripts/computed-route/state-map.mjs --check fails on an entry whose walker states the surface no longer has or that map elsewhere. No group is named today.
